title: Exact power-basis data of one multiplet: d<d>/m<N>/exact.json (small d only)
description: Generated by `sic-inspect --exact-json IN.sicx OUT.json` from a finalized SICX file. The field K = Q(omega) and the tower K = F_0 < F_1 < ... < F_t = L, F_{i+1} = F_i(g_i), appear once (variables omega, g0, g1, ...; adjoin in the order of extension_order). An element of F_n is {denominator, coefficients}: coefficients[e] = [x, y] is the coefficient (x + y*omega)/denominator of the monomial g0^e0 g1^e1 ... g_{n-1}^e_{n-1}, e = e0 + p0*e1 + p0*p1*e2 + ... (little-endian mixed radix over the tower degrees), so coefficients has p0*...*p_{n-1} entries. Per-ray coordinates are the d unnormalized coordinates psi_0 .. psi_{d-1} (elements of L), keyed by the ray id d<d>-m<N>-c<N>; the published normalized vector is psi/||psi|| * conj(psi_a)/|psi_a| (a = anchor). Every number is a decimal string. Complex conjugation is stored as an exact ring automorphism of L (images of omega and of every g_i), which the verifier needs because the autocorrelation test uses conj(psi_k). The root balls are decimal boxes [mid, radius] per part, each certified at generation to contain exactly one root of the level polynomial (interval Newton on the published balls of the lower levels), and the power-basis coordinates evaluated at them overlap the BALL chunk of the SICX file.

multiplet.description: release multiplet id m<N> (required, supplied with --multiplet)

polynomial.description: minimal polynomial of omega over Q as an infix string

polynomial_coefficients.description: Rational base: [0,1] for omega; quadratic base: [c0,c1,1] for omega^2+c1*omega+c0

embedding.description: Derived from d: omega -> 0 for rational K; -sqrt(D0) for D0 != 1 mod 4; (1-sqrt(D0))/2 otherwise, using the prescribed real or imaginary square root

extension_order.description: omega, g0, g1, ...: each variable is adjoined to the field generated by the previous ones

polynomial.description: monic minimal polynomial of g_i over F_i, coefficients low to high; each coefficient is an element of F_i

polynomial_infix.description: the same polynomial as an infix string in omega, g0, ..., g_i (GP/Sage/Mathematica syntax)

root.description: decimal box [mid, radius] per part: the unique root of the level polynomial (coefficients evaluated at the published balls of the lower levels) in the box is iota(g_i)

branch.description: the SICX META branch rectangle (Arb dump strings), which the root box overlaps

galois_element.description: Smith word of complex conjugation in Gal(L/K); empty when conjugation does not fix K (d = 2)
